title: HVAC and Plumbing in Somerset, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in Somerset, TX, and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: Reliable HVAC is important in your Somerset, TX, home to make sure that you are comfortable all year round. You also need running water that you can depend on. From your heat and AC to your sewer line, your garbage disposal, and more, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air provides HVAC and plumbing services. We can install, maintain, and repair these systems.
No matter what services you require, our team of expert HVAC techs and plumbers can help. Contact us today!

Our hot summers mean that AC is not just something you need for comfort, but also for safety and health. We can install your AC and perform regular maintenance to keep it running efficiently. If you’re having problems, we can fix what’s wrong.

Our winters may be mild, but that doesn’t mean you don’t also need reliable heating when the temperature drops. We understand this, and we’ll do our best to make sure you have uninterrupted heating all winter.

We recommend regular maintenance for your heating system to avoid cold-weather breakdowns and ensure its optimal efficiency. Maintenance also extends the life of both your heating and cooling systems. We offer a cost-effective maintenance plan, the Comfort Club, that takes the stress out of scheduling routine tune-ups. Ask us for more information!

If you’re concerned about indoor air quality, we offer a variety of solutions. Air purifiers and UV lights can help remove contaminants from the air. Dehumidifiers can help control mold, mildew, and even dust indoors.

If there’s anything you rely on more than your heating and cooling system, it’s your plumbing. You also need to know that your water is clean and safe to drink. Ignoring a problem with your pipes, drains, or water heater can lead to property damage and health issues. It’s also more likely that fixing leaks, clogs, and other problems is less costly when promptly addressed.

However, one problem with leaks is that they can occur without your noticing them. Bad smells, mold, mildew, low water pressure, and unexplained damp spots all suggest a potential leak. Our leak detection services can locate and repair them before they cause further damage.

Clogs in your drains can be localized, or they can be an early warning of damage further down the line. Our camera inspections can identify the source of the clog, allowing us to provide the right fix.

Having a working sump pump is critical to prevent damage to your home in case of heavy rain and flooding. You should test your sump pump regularly to ensure it continues to operate correctly. If it’s struggling to pump water, making strange noises, or showing other problems, you should schedule service. Needing a replacement sump pump or any plumbing system requires a flexible budget, and oftentimes, homeowners don’t have wiggle room. That’s why we provide financing on approved credit.
We’re eager to be your go-to company for all your plumbing and HVAC needs in the Somerset area. Contact Rosenberg Plumbing & Air today to schedule your service.
